source: Picked from Destination Bryan, Visit College Station and the Bush Library (Nov 2026); refreshed with the weekly update

spots.name: Lake Walk
spots.blurb: Paved trails around Lake Atlas and a 75-foot Lookout Tower; nice at sunset.
spots.blurbEs: Senderos pavimentados alrededor del lago Atlas y una torre mirador de 23 metros; bonito al atardecer.

spots.name: George H.W. Bush Presidential Library and Museum
spots.blurb: Presidential museum with a full-size airplane and rotating exhibits; kids 5 and under free.
spots.blurbEs: Museo presidencial con un avión de tamaño real y exposiciones temporales; menores de 5 años gratis.

spots.name: The Gardens at Texas A&M
spots.blurb: Campus gardens with walking paths and seasonal holiday strolls.
spots.blurbEs: Jardines del campus con senderos y paseos navideños de temporada.

spots.name: Sue Haswell Memorial Park
spots.blurb: Lit holiday pathways from late November, open for evening walks.
spots.blurbEs: Senderos iluminados por las fiestas desde fines de noviembre, abiertos para caminar de noche.

spots.name: Clara B. Mounce Library
spots.blurb: Downtown library with a big Texas-shaped tree and the free Peppermint Path light display.
spots.blurbEs: Biblioteca del centro con un gran árbol en forma de Texas y Peppermint Path, una exhibición de luces gratuita.

spots.name: Boonville Heritage Park
spots.blurb: Historic park with the Turner-Peters log house and walking trails.
spots.blurbEs: Parque histórico con la cabaña de troncos Turner-Peters y senderos para caminar.
